name: NovaRoma_Playability_Layer_FullFixturesPlus_BootstrapDefaults
milestone_generation_policy: When a new initiative is created, generate an initial milestone with a deterministic ID and a default description based on the initiative's purpose.

STATUS.description: Summarize governance/pop/ops/risks/summary for an entity or site.

SITE_REPORT.description: Generate the standard site report with North/Central/South District tables + Top 3 Issues/Risks.

INITIATIVE_CREATE.description: Create a new initiative with goals, constraints, and optional first milestones.

MILESTONE_ADD.description: Add milestones to an initiative. IDs follow <year>-<serial> within initiative start year counting.

ADVANCE:3D.description: Advance in-campaign time by 3 days and report completed milestones during the window.

MILESTONES_REPORT.description: Render the milestones report (COMPLETED / IN PROGRESS / PLANNED grouped by initiative / SUMMARY / FOOTER).

RENDER_GRID.description: Render ASCII/emoji map slices from METRO or NovaRoma subgrid using shoreline segments and offsets.

numeric_generation_policy.intent: Allow generating numbers ONLY for newly created entities or newly initiated estimates, while preserving non-invention for existing facts.

rules.name: No invention for existing entities
rules.text: If an entity already exists in state or canon, do not generate new population/GDP/capacity/tech values unless sourced from an explicit measurement milestone result.

rules.name: Allowed for new creations
rules.text: When creating a new site/asset/initiative output that requires a number (e.g., initial pop, area, weekly output), you may generate a value IF it is explicitly labeled as an estimate and accompanied by a rationale and range.

rules.name: Estimate labeling
rules.text: Generated numbers must be tagged with 'est' and include: basis, plausible range, and confidence (low/med/high).

rules.name: Anchoring and constraints
rules.text: Generated numbers must respect the campaign tech constraints (Late Iron Age) and local geography. Avoid implausible scaling; prefer conservative outputs.

rules.name: Determinism option
rules.text: If a random draw is used, record RNG method and seed in audit.log so results are repeatable.

new_outpost_population.basis: Small shore outpost sized for a few extended families + laborers; constrained by food storage and shelter capacity.

weekly_fish_catch.basis: Beach-seine + hook-and-line with limited preservation; scales with boats, nets, and labor hours.

charcoal_output.basis: Earth-mound kilns; output depends on timber supply and burn management; early ramp conservative.

ugrid_generation_rules: UGRID(MANHATTAN): use only segments where name=='Manhattan'.
UGRID(LAND_ALL): union segments for all landmasses (already non-overlapping).
Waterways are implicit as any cell not covered by a land segment.

repo_integration.intent: Provide Copilot enough structure to implement the playability layer as code in a GitHub repo.

recommended_repo_layout.README.md: How to run the campaign engine; command examples; canon links.

state/.state.json: Mutable campaign facts (sites, initiatives, milestones, trackers).
state/.event_log.jsonl: Append-only event log (one JSON object per line).

engine/.reducers.ts: Pure functions that transform state based on commands/events.
engine/.renderers.ts: Report renderers (Status, Site Report, Milestones Report, Trackers).
engine/.maps.ts: Grid render utilities using shoreline segments.

tests/.canon_rules.test.ts: Tests that enforce non-invention rules, formatting rules.

examples: initiative create "Harbor Works" purpose="Build durable docks"
milestone add initiative="Explore" name="Freshwater Survey" target_date="Mar 4, 509 BCE"
normalization_rules: Trim, lowercase for parsing; preserve original for audit.
Allow shorthand targets: nr -> Nova Roma; agri -> agriculture.
If command is unrecognized, return help with nearest matches.

non_invention_guards: Existing entities: do not overwrite population/GDP/capacity/tech unless measurement event references a milestone result.
Generated numbers for new creations must use estimate_object_schema and include est label, range, basis, confidence.

products.notes: Indigenous staple; high yield; stores well
High calories per area; cool tolerant

notes: Reference reducers are canonical, correctness-first state transitions expressed as structured pseudocode.
They are designed to be easy for Copilot to translate into real code (e.g., TypeScript reducers).
Reducers should be pure: no I/O. I/O (printing reports, writing files) happens in a thin runtime wrapper.

common_conventions.purity: Reducers return {new_state, emitted_events, outputs}. They do not write files directly.
common_conventions.date_handling: Use an in-campaign date library or a deterministic date-table; preserve MMM D, YYYY formatting.

invariants: Do not modify entities, trackers, or milestones as a result of STATUS.
Respect non-invention rules: do not fabricate new factual numbers for existing entities.
steps: Normalize target (e.g., 'nr' -> 'Nova Roma', 'agri' -> 'agriculture').
Resolve target to an entity/tracker known in state or canon.
Render sections per canon: Governance/Authority, Population, Operations, Risks, Summary.
If data absent, render 'unknown' or omit numeric detail (unless it is a permitted estimate already stored in state).
Optionally append an audit.log entry noting the query (no state change required).

invariants: Do not create or mutate sites; SITE_REPORT only renders what's in state.
Unknowns are valid; do not invent populations/GDP/capacity/technology.
steps: Collect sites from state.entities.sites.
Partition into North/Central/South districts using site.district if present; else default all to 'Central' (or render 'unknown district').
Sort within district by population if known; otherwise stable sort by name.
Render table columns exactly as canon site_report.table_columns.
Render Top 3 Issues/Risks using available state.risks or infer as 'unknown' without fabricating numbers.

invariants: Initiative names must be unique (case-insensitive) within state.
Do not alter existing initiatives/milestones; only append new ones.
If initial milestones are included, they must comply with milestone id/date rules.
steps: Validate required args: name, purpose (and optionally owner, constraints, initial_milestones).
Ensure initiative name does not already exist.
Create initiative object with fields: name, purpose, owner (default: player_role), constraints[], created_on (campaign date), start_year_index (see id generation).
Append to state.entities.initiatives.
If initial_milestones provided: call MILESTONE_ADD reducer logic to append them with correct IDs and status=PLANNED.
Append audit.log entry noting creation.

input.command: initiative create "Harbor Works" purpose="Build durable docks"

invariants: Milestone IDs follow ^\d+-\d+$ and are unique within an initiative.
Only milestones receive IDs (no IDs for initiatives or reports).
Target dates must follow canon date format.

id_generation.rule: Within each initiative, compute year_index = floor(days_since_initiative_start / 365) + 1. serial = count(existing milestones in same year_index) + 1. id = f"{year_index}-{serial}".
id_generation.note: If campaign uses BCE/CE, year_index is relative to initiative start, not absolute calendar year.

steps: Resolve initiative by name; if not found, error.
For each new milestone draft: validate name/description, target_date string, impact.
Generate milestone id per rule (unless explicitly provided AND valid AND non-colliding).
Set status=PLANNED, progress=0, created_on=current campaign date.
Append to state.entities.milestones.
Append audit.log entry and emit events.

input.command: milestone add initiative="Explore" name="Freshwater Survey" target_date="Mar 4, 509 BCE" impact="Maps springs"

invariants: Never fabricate measurement results; only milestone statuses can change based on time passing.
If a milestone becomes COMPLETED, it must appear in the next milestones report COMPLETED section.
steps: Compute new campaign date = current_date + 3 days.
For each milestone with target_date within (old_date, new_date] and status in {PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS}: set status=COMPLETED and progress=100.
Optionally advance IN_PROGRESS milestones toward completion if you maintain a work model; otherwise leave progress unchanged.
Set state.calendar.current_date = new_date.
Append audit.log entry recording the advance window.
Call MILESTONES_REPORT rendering logic for the same window and return it as output.

invariants: Report must contain canon sections and columns exactly.
Do not alter milestone status within this reducer; it only renders.
steps: Partition milestones into COMPLETED / IN_PROGRESS / PLANNED.
Render COMPLETED and IN_PROGRESS as tables using canon columns.
Render PLANNED grouped by initiative; each initiative gets its own table.
Render SUMMARY: high-level notes from state (no fabricated stats).
Render FOOTER with Pop and GDP deltas as unknown/est unless state contains permitted estimates.

invariants: Rendering uses shoreline segments; land = '.', water = '~' per map meta.
Origin must be SW (row=0,col=0), row increases north, col increases east.
steps: Select map: METRO (full) or NovaRoma_UGRID35 (subgrid).
If subgrid: convert requested ugrid rows/cols to metro rows/cols using offsets from map.subgrid_mapping.
For each row in requested range: initialize all cells as water.
Mark land cells where west<=col<=east for segments matching mask (e.g., Manhattan only) or union for all landmasses.
Emit text lines; optional coordinate ruler is allowed but must not change the underlying cell characters.

input.command: render grid map=NovaRoma_UGRID35 row_range=0..10 col_range=0..60 mask=Manhattan

bootstrap_defaults.notes: Bootstrap should create state/state.json from state_templates/state.json by copying. Templates remain immutable.

general_engine_rules: The engine is allowed to auto-estimate annualized values, GDP splits, and time-to-relief using defined formulas instead of manual inputs.
notes: Canon Impact (CI) labels should be human-readable; avoid JSON-path labels in CI middle segment.
